host: Zen4 7800X3D, native Windows, MSVC addon, AVX-512 auto

badges.detail: PAR2 create, 1 GiB / 1024 slices (1 MiB), R=8; native Windows. GFNI+AVX-512 reference; pow2 slice count for direct PAR3 comparison. 5 invocations, per-run 646.87 / 643.22 / 639.60 / 643.62 / 639.60, median 643.22, mean 642.58, stdev 2.72 (0.4%).

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 1024 slices (1 MiB blocks), R=8, matvec Cauchy kernel (N=1024 < BARY_MIN_INPUTS_DEFAULT=10000 and R=8 < FENGER_MIN_R=8192); native Windows. 5 runs after 120 s idle for AVX-512 thermal recovery, per-run 719.61 / 702.81 / 681.30 / 685.41 / 728.83, median 702.81, mean 703.59, stdev 19.46 (2.8%). 1.09x PAR2 at the same shape.

PAR2 create, 1 GiB / 32768 slices (32 KiB), R=8; native Windows. PAR2's GFNI+AVX-512 is the speed reference for the PAR3 rows. 5 invocations, per-run 636.42 / 638.80 / 638.40 / 630.54 / 638.80, median 638.40, mean 636.59, stdev 3.18 (0.5%). The bench's default --recovery=10% would give 3276 recovery slices at this input count and ~137 MB/s; the badge requires --recovery=8.

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 32768 slices (32 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel (R=8 < FENGER_MIN_R=8192); native Windows. 4 runs after 120 s idle (run 1 JIT-warmup outlier discarded for the median): per-run 544.39 / 648.10 / 629.77 / 633.66, post-warmup median 633.66, mean 637.18, stdev 7.74 (1.2%). Matches PAR2 throughput on coarse slicing.

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 131072 slices (8 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel; native Windows. 4 runs, per-run 474.0 / 482.0 / 472.0 / 512.0, median 478.0, mean 485.0, stdev 16.4 (3.4%, run 4 = 512 MB/s JIT-warmup recovery).

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 262144 slices (4 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel; native Windows. 4 runs, per-run 288.0 / 326.0 / 332.0 / 338.0, median 332.0, mean 321.0, stdev 19.4 (6.0%, run 1 = 288 MB/s JIT-warmup outlier).

PAR3 create, 10 GiB / 131072 slices (78 KiB blocks), R=8. 78 KiB is not a power of 2 — rejected at lib/par3gen.js:1263 with 'Block size must be a power of 2'; pending. To re-enable, use 80 KiB or 64 KiB blocks. Row absent from the README table (was removed in PR #99); entry kept for badge-id stability.

PAR3 create, 10 GiB / 262144 slices (40 KiB blocks), R=8. 40 KiB is not a power of 2 — rejected at lib/par3gen.js:1263 with 'Block size must be a power of 2'; pending. To re-enable, use 64 KiB blocks (but 10 GiB / 64 KiB = 163840 slices, not a power of 2) or fall back to PAR2 for arbitrary block sizes. Row absent from the README table (was removed in PR #99); entry kept for badge-id stability.

PAR3 create, 4 GiB / 65536 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel; native Windows. Largest pow2 shape that fits `buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` (Node 22+). Chunked create path (PR #108): input pool capped at 64 MiB via `poolSize = min(poolCap, max(64 MiB, totalSize + 64 KiB))` (lib/par3gen.js:633, where `poolCap` defaults to 64 MiB), reset between batches via `_resetInputBufferPool` (lib/par3gen.js:620). 2 standalone runs (120 s cooldown between rows): per-run 768.05 / 825.14, median 796.60, mean 796.60, stdev 40.36 (5.1%). Peak RSS 372 MiB.

PAR3 create, 14 GiB / 229376 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel (R=8 < FENGER_MIN_R=8192); native Windows. The README row historically used R=32768 to force the Fenger path (Bostan-Schost MPE; R >= FENGER_MIN_R; non-pow2 input count N=229376 is padded up to next_pow2=262144). However the Fenger path crashes on this host with `TypeError: hash.copy is not a function` at lib/par3gen.js:2930 — a Node.js 22 worker_threads Buffer-view detachment bug, pre-existing in master, not introduced by PR #111. Fell back to R=8 (Barycentric) which works correctly. 2 runs after 120 s cooldown: per-run 798.13 / 824.19, median 811.16, mean 811.16, stdev 18.43 (2.3%). Peak RSS 343 MiB.

PAR3 create, 16 GiB / 262144 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel (R=8 < FENGER_MIN_R=8192); native Windows. Requires Node 22+ (Buffer.alloc(16 GiB) succeeds under buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER). Chunked create path (PR #108): input pool capped at 64 MiB and reset between batches. 2 runs after 180 s cooldown: per-run 840.85 / 809.69, median 825.27, mean 825.27, stdev 22.05 (2.7%). Peak RSS 345 MiB.

PAR3 create, 32 GiB / 524288 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel (R=8 < FENGER_MIN_R=8192); native Windows. Chunked create path (PR #108): input pool capped at 64 MiB and reset between batches; peak RSS bounded to working-set size, not the full input. 2 runs after 240 s cooldown: per-run 711.06 / 584.62, median 647.84, mean 647.84, stdev 89.50 (13.8%, run 2 catches JIT-warmup recovery after the first long bench leg). Peak RSS 352 MiB.

PAR3 create, 64 GiB / 1048576 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Barycentric kernel (R=8 < FENGER_MIN_R=8192); native Windows. Chunked create path (PR #108) breaks the 64 GiB memory wall: input pool capped at 64 MiB and reset between batches, so the working set stays bounded regardless of source size. 2 runs after 300 s cooldown: per-run 561.17 / 545.40, median 553.28, mean 553.28, stdev 11.16 (2.0%). Peak RSS 341 MiB.
